english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken noun for assistance, and it can also mean a person or thing that is useful in a task.

exampleSentences.english: I need your help right now.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 bong1 sau2

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial noun for ordinary help or assistance.

exampleSentences.english: Can you give me some assistance moving this table?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你可唔可以幫手搬張枱？
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 bun1 zoeng1 toi4

english.note: Use 幫手 as a noun for assistance, especially in phrases such as asking for or thanking someone for their help.

exampleSentences.english: Thanks for lending a hand this time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2
